name: Ran-D housekeeper droid
description: Ran-D housekeeper droids were hovering droids that maintained living spaces. Mama the Hutt kept at least two Ran-D housekeeper droids at her household on Nal Hutta. She had the droids feed her at dinner time. This type of droid also appeared in a cantina owned by an Ithorian bartender in the Bilbousa Bazaar on Nal Hutta.
